structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a same-name copy of "Effective Accelerationism" (e/acc). A canonical-looking e/acc token already trades at about $20.7M market cap with $637k liquidity; its pair was created about 9.5 hours earlier. This copy was not launched on pump.fun's curve. The creator made the token and a PumpSwap pool within 3 seconds and supplied the liquidity directly. 100% of that LP is unlocked and the creator's wallet now holds 0 tokens. In 14 minutes the pair traded about $690k of volume on a $17k market cap (about 24x turnover). There were 1,691 unique buyers but only 102 unique sellers, and 65 wallets are tagged as bundlers. Price is up about 60% but still sits near its all-time high of about $19.9k market cap. The only social link points to a Beff Jezos X status, which is borrowed attention from the main e/acc narrative.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos meme. The narrative is live today because an e/acc token has reached about $20M. This token rides spillover from that coin rather than owning the story.
narrative.why_spreading: The main e/acc token is hot, and search or sniper bots plus unwary buyers hit same-name copies. The very high buyer count at this tiny market cap fits copycat spillover and bot routing more than organic discovery.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name and ticker, plus a link to a Beff Jezos tweet. There is no website, no socials and no DexScreener profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m... e/acc at $20.7M market cap with $637k liquidity, launched about 9.5 hours earlier, which is the clear leader. GqmEdRD...pump e/acc from 2024 at $163k market cap.

authenticity.evidence: There are 1,691 unique buyers against only 102 unique sellers, with 1,441 sell transactions. A small set of wallets is repeatedly selling into a wide spread of buys. There are 65 bundler wallets. Turnover of about 24x market cap in 14 minutes is extreme. The creator seeded unlocked LP directly, holds 0 tokens, and has no curve history.
authenticity.uncertainty: The many small buyers could be real traders confused by the ticker or chasing the e/acc spillover. GMGN's bot/degen and fresh-wallet rates are low, which argues somewhat against pure bot volume.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked and controlled by the deployer, who can pull it at any time
The creator added liquidity directly rather than through a pump.fun migration, a classic copycat-rug setup
A copycat of a $20M token, so it is easy for community and bots to discredit
Liquidity only about $28k against about $690k of volume churn

structured_output.counterargument: Demand is very broad: about 1,700 buyers and holders, top-10 holders at only about 15%, mint and freeze authority renounced, and a creator holding 0 tokens. At $17k market cap against a $20M sister token, one spillover wave from the e/acc crowd could push this copy to $35k or more quickly. Low-cap e/acc beta plays sometimes do run several-fold before anyone pulls the LP.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a ticker-hijack copy of a $20M e/acc token. It has deployer-controlled, fully unlocked LP, bundlers, and a lopsided buyer/seller structure that looks like extraction. The volume is real, but the most likely outcome is an LP pull or a bleed once the volume burst ends. The chance of a 2x before -50% exists but is below the pool average.
